title: filesystem transport: queue_unbind does not update the exchange file, so unbound queues keep receiving messages
author: moneebullah25
body_preview: On the `filesystem://` transport, `Channel.queue_unbind` does not persist the removal of a binding. The in-memory `state.binding_delete` does run, so only the exchange file on disk is stale. The binding stays in the exchange file, so later direct/fanout publishes (including from other processes) are still routed to the unbound queue. title: RQ cron scheduler does not respect Django TIME_ZONE
author: chromium7
body_preview: ## Summary  Cron expressions registered through `django_rq` are evaluated in UTC instead of the timezone configured in Django's `TIME_ZONE`.
